The Bulldogs were led by second-year head coach [[Chris Jans]], and played their home games at [[Humphrey Coliseum]] in [[Mississippi State, Mississippi]], just outside [[Starkville, Mississippi|Starkville]], as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Bulldogs]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 20–11, 8–10 in [[2021–22 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to tie for 9th place. They defeated [[2022–23 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]] in the second round of the [[2023 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] before losing to [[2022–23 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Alabama]] in the quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA Tournament]] as an 11th seed, where they lost in the First Four play-in round to [[2022–23 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team|Pittsburgh]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
